labels.rationale: Already supported via show_header=False on Table; usage question.

body:
Rich already supports this. Pass `show_header=False` when you create the table, and the header row and its separator are not rendered:

```python
from rich.console import Console
from rich.table import Table

table = Table(show_header=False)
table.add_column("Service")
table.add_column("Status")
table.add_row("api", "ok")
Console().print(table)
```

The option is documented in [tables.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst). The related bug report #944 covers a border glitch in header-less tables, so it may be relevant if you see that rendering.

For questions like this, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
